title: Left Desk
story: An empty workstation has four approval stamps assigned to one hand. Ivo explains that holding a familiar letter briefly can become a modifier. The engineer learns each left-hand hold on its own, then types the same letters as text.

steps.objective: Listen to Ivo at the left desk.
Use the four left-hand stamps one at a time.
Type the approval note: letters as text, one capital.
Complete the mixed approval sheet without a diagram.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Hold F (Shift), tap K on the other hand, and finish the name: capitalize the K in Kai.
success_criteria: Shift + K is observed (Shift held from F, then K on the other hand)
The local sheet shows the stamp's effect

task.prompt: Approval sheet: stamp with Shift + K. Safe local editor; no OS shortcut is required.
task.accepts: text K typed as a capital

steps.expect: hold F until Shift engages (about 200 ms), then tap K
rejects: the plain letters of both keys typed as text (a same-hand or too-early press)

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the sheet; the stamp needs the hold on the first key, then the opposite-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

task.hold_timing: about 200 ms; release order does not matter for the score
task.activation_order: one hold at a time in this level

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Type a short approval note where the same letters appear as text: same-hand rolls stay letters, and one capital needs a real Shift hold.
success_criteria: The note reads Kai desk fad sad exactly
d, f, s and a typed as plain letters in rolls did not become modifiers or shortcuts

feedback.other: A held D becomes Command. Tap D and release quickly.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Complete an approval sheet that mixes all four stamps in one pass, with no diagram: capitalize, italicize, mark and lock.
success_criteria: Shift, Command, Option and Control stamps each appear once in the observed events
The sheet's four lines match their targets

task.prompt: Approval sheet (no diagram): four lines, one stamp each.
task.accepts: each stamp event observed once per line, in any order the sheet asks

feedback.other: The observed output is shown above the sheet; the stamp needs the hold on the first key, then the opposite-hand key. Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: This workstation has four approval stamps and one hand to work them. Holding a familiar letter briefly turns it into a modifier.

dialogue.speaker: stamp_card
dialogue.text: To italicize the approval note, you need to press Command + I.

hint.action: To italicize the approval note, you need to press Command + I.
hint.gesture: Command is tap-hold D, then I on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: stamp_card
dialogue.text: To capitalize the K in Kai, you need to press Shift + K.

hint.action: To capitalize the K in Kai, you need to press Shift + K.

dialogue.speaker: stamp_card
dialogue.text: To type the `d` in "desk", you need to press D.

hint.action: To type the `d` in "desk", you need to press D.
hint.gesture: tap D. No hold, no modifier.

dialogue.speaker: stamp_card
dialogue.text: To mark the sheet, you need to press Option + K.

hint.action: To mark the sheet, you need to press Option + K.
hint.gesture: Option is tap-hold S, then K on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: stamp_card
dialogue.text: To lock the sheet, you need to press Control + L.

hint.action: To lock the sheet, you need to press Control + L.
hint.gesture: Control is tap-hold A, then L on the other hand.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: Four stamps, four sheets, and the lamp is on. The pinboard will want them.

dialogue.speaker: ivo
dialogue.text: That training card describes a shorter workflow than the script I was given.
dialogue.cue: Ivo 04: when the player shows the optional Training card

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: The first printing lists fewer steps than Pace's current script.
dialogue.cue: Engineer: inspecting a tampering artifact (Training card, first printing)

then.text: Orientation 04 complete: the left desk is lit.

state_changes.before: The cherry desk is dark, the corridor stripe beside it is unlit and the pinboard beside the elevator is empty.
state_changes.after: The desk lamp wakes and the corridor stripe lights; the four approved sheets join the pinboard.

the four approved sheets join the pinboard

pace_copy.text: Approved route: left desk, then left desk.

review_notes: At 1366x768 the left desk stop (7,10) is west of centre; the camera clamps at the west edge so the avatar stands at screen (120,100): inside the keyboard inset's x range but above its top edge (y 103), and the desk row sits above it (screen y 84-100). The sheet is readable with the inset open.
